schoolName: University of San Carlos of Guatemala Faculty of Medical Sciences
reviewNotes: HOLD — USAC's Faculty of Medical Sciences offers the in-person Médico y Cirujano degree at the Centro Universitario Metropolitano. Its official 2026 registration guide lists a seven-year course and entry tests, while the faculty's applicant system publishes the specific-test route. The official student support page references economic-investment and scholarship information but did not provide a current, citable fee schedule in the material reviewed. No official international-applicant pathway, language-of-instruction statement, current international fee package, or independently corroborated recognition pathway suitable for this site's study-abroad medical payload was found. Do not publish until those requirements are verified.
